newsitem.title: USA: TWA won't add domestic cargo fuel surcharge.
newsitem.headline: TWA won't add domestic cargo fuel surcharge.

text.p: Trans World Airlines Inc said Thursday it will not implement a previously announced $0.025 per pound domestic cargo fuel surcharge on December 1.
However, it said internationally it will apply a cargo fuel surcharge of $0.06 per kilo on all Air Freight shipments, Priority Air Express and next flight out shipments, effective December 1.
For international shipments originating outside the United States, the fuel surcharge of $0.06 per kilo will be applied in local currency, TWA said.
